newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Colombo stocks end lower as blue chips dominate.
newsitem.headline: Colombo stocks end lower as blue chips dominate.

text.p: Sri Lanka's stock market ended lower on Tuesday, with interest in blue chips dragging the index down but boosting turnover, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.03 points down at 620.86. Price declines outnumbered gains by 25 to 20, led by highly capitalised Development Finance Corporation, which fell five rupees to 270 rupees.
Turnover was 45.9 million rupees on 1.1 million shares. The main trades were local buying of 73,500 Commercial Bank and 165,400 Richard Pieris & Co, both blue chips.
Foreign buying was worth 7.9 million rupees and selling was 31.1 million rupees.
"Whether local or foreign, there is interest in a selected band of finance and manufacturing stocks," said Deva Ellepola, a broker at Jardine Fleming.
Interested parties were, however, unwilling to show their hand fearing that such a move would hit prices, brokers said.
